metadata.//: A list of websites I have created and are showcasing, with links to the live sites and brief descriptions. This is a JSON file that can be used to generate a portfolio or showcase of my work.

sites.description: A football management website that showcases the saves and runs of Jamie Harper's career on Top Eleven, Online Soccer Manager, and Hattrick.
A website for a creative craft business, showcasing their classes and services.
Voice acting portfolio website showcasing the client's work in various projects, including video games and animations.
An official website for the Xeno Championship esports tournament, featuring current standings, match schedules, and a Hall of Fame.
A website for Oakshift Software, showcasing their software products and services.
A website for the Orbital Conservation Institute, showcasing their projects, software and research in the field of orbital conservation.
